title: Members Of Parliament Salaries And Allowances Amendment Act 2005

sections.shortTitle: Members Of Parliament Salaries And Allowances Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2005
ACT V OF 2005
Members Of Parliament (Salaries And Allowances)
(Amendment) Act 2005
An Act further to amend
the Members of Parliament
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act
may be called the Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances (Amendment)
Act, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Members Of Parliament Salaries And Allowances Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Substitution of section 14B, Act XXVII of 1974

ACT V OF 2005
ACT V OF 2005
Members Of Parliament (Salaries And Allowances)
(Amendment) Act 2005
An Act further to amend
the Members of Parliament
(Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 17th May, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑
2. Substitution of section
14B, Act XXVII of 1974. In the
Members of Parliament (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 (XXVII of 1974), for
section 14B, the following shall be substituted, namely:‑
"14B. Increase in
emoluments.--The salaries, allowances and privileges of Members shall
automatically be increased by the Federal Government in proportion to the
increase in the emoluments of the civil servants."
